mapper.sql: CASE WHEN content_type_id = '32' THEN 'stay' WHEN content_type_id IN ('12', '14', '15', '28', '38') THEN 'tour' WHEN COALESCE(biz_type, '') ~ '스터디카페|PC방|노래방|키즈카페' THEN 'etc' WHEN COALESCE(biz_type, '') ~ '카페|커피|디저트|베이커리|케이크|도넛|와플|아이스크림|베이글|크레페|^차$' THEN 'cafe' WHEN COALESCE(biz_type, '') ~ '이자카야|주점|맥주|호프|포장마차|바\(BAR\)|와인' THEN 'bar' ELSE 'food' END

id, source, name, COALESCE(NULLIF(biz_type, ''), CASE content_type_id WHEN '12' THEN '관광지' WHEN '14' THEN '문화시설' WHEN '15' THEN '축제·행사' WHEN '28' THEN '레포츠' WHEN '32' THEN '숙박' WHEN '38' THEN '쇼핑' WHEN '39' THEN '음식점' ELSE '관광지' END) AS category, address, tel, latitude AS lat, longitude AS lng, use_time, rest_date, image_url, rating, review_count, amenities, map_url, AS kind
mapper.select:
SELECT , ST_Distance(geom, ) AS distance FROM retrip_place WHERE name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR biz_type ILIKE '%' || #{kind} || '%'
OR biz_type ~ #{groupPattern} OR (content_type_id = '39' AND COALESCE(biz_type, '') !~ #{notFoodPattern}) ORDER BY
geom <-> COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC, name
LIMIT 20
SELECT , ST_Distance(geom, ) AS distance FROM retrip_place WHERE ST_DWithin(geom, , #{radius}) AND () = #{kind} AND COALESCE(rating, 4.0) >= 3.0 ORDER BY DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE address ILIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN source IN ('tour', 'sample') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE name = #{name} OR name ILIKE '%' || #{name} || '%' OR (char_length(name) >= 3 AND #{name} ILIKE '%' || name || '%') ORDER BY (name = #{name}) DESC, COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT content FROM retrip_review WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY length(content) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH score AS ( SELECT s.place_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.state = 'done' THEN 1.0 WHEN s.state = 'todo' THEN 0.3 ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN t.start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS score, COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) FILTER (WHERE s.state = 'done') AS visitors FROM trip_stop s JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE s.place_id IS NOT NULL AND t.member_id <> #{memberId} AND t.start_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 30 AND CURRENT_DATE + 30 GROUP BY s.place_id ), mine AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.place_id FROM trip_stop s JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = s.trip_id WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.state = 'done' AND s.place_id IS NOT NULL AND t.start_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 ) SELECT , ST_Distance(geom, ) AS distance, COALESCE(sc.score, 0) AS score, COALESCE(sc.visitors, 0) AS visitors FROM retrip_place LEFT JOIN score sc ON sc.place_id = retrip_place.id WHERE (rating IS NULL OR rating >= 3.0) AND content_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM '32' AND id NOT IN (SELECT place_id FROM mine) AND ST_DWithin(geom, , #{radius}) ORDER BY COALESCE(sc.score, 0) DESC, DESC LIMIT #{limit}
